hbond_criterion: donor-acceptor O...O distance < 3.5 A AND angle O_donor-H...O_acceptor > 150 deg (vertex at H), acceptor on a different molecule than donor
dash_definition: dashes connect donor-H (the donor-water hydrogen satisfying the angle criterion) to acceptor-O; PDB atom serials of analysis/cluster_<tag>.pdb
connectivity_disclaimer: Drawn local clusters have 15 (300 K) vs 14 (273 K) drawn H-bonds; the quantitative 273 K increase (2.775±0.040 vs 2.572±0.039 H-bonds/water) comes from the full 100-frame accepted analysis, not these snapshots.

re-rendered identical style, tighter framing, dashes H->O
captions = whole-frame counts; footer disclaimer on all panels and side-by-side
